additions: (e) A person also shall register under this section if the person received a stay of adjudication under section 609.095, paragraph (b), for a charge of violating section 243.166; 609.342; 609.343; 609.344; 609.345; 609.3451, subdivision 3; 609.3453; 617.246; or 617.247, unless the offender is a juvenile and the court finds, on the record, that there is good cause to waive the registration requirement.
